definitions.explanation: a person who performs acrobatics, juggling, or other feats of physical skill

examples.japanese: ⟦サーカス→サーカス：20826_saakasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曲芸師|きょくげいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The circus acrobat showed an amazing trick.

examples.japanese: {曲芸師|きょくげいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{綱|つな}→綱：03891_tsuna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: The acrobat is riding a bicycle on a tightrope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦サーカス→サーカス：20826_saakasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曲芸師|きょくげいし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}っている→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: Having grown up in the circus since childhood, she travels the world as a top-class acrobat.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{曲芸|きょくげい}→曲芸：15699_kyokugei⟧ (acrobatics/tricks) and {師|し} (master/professional). Refers to professional performers of acrobatic feats, juggling, and similar physical skills. While associated with circuses, traditional Japanese ⟦{曲芸|きょくげい}→曲芸：15699_kyokugei⟧ also includes street performance traditions dating back centuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦サーカス→サーカス：20826_saakasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曲芸師|きょくげいし}: circus acrobat
- {大道|だいどう}{曲芸師|きょくげいし}: street performer
- {曲芸師|きょくげいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: acrobat's trick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{曲芸|きょくげい}→曲芸：15699_kyokugei⟧: acrobatics — the art itself rather than the performer
- ⟦{大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}→大道芸人：29758_daidougeinin⟧: street performer — broader term for any street entertainer
- {軽業師|かるわざし}: acrobat — older, more literary term emphasizing lightness and agility
- ジャグラー: juggler — specifically someone who juggles
